stem:
The diagram shows Sana's rectangle with corners labelled $P$, $Q$, $R$, $S$ in order going around the boundary. A valid name may start at any corner and then follow that travel order.

Which name is valid for that rectangle?

options.text: Rectangle $QRSP$ is valid: it lists corners in boundary travel order, starting at $Q$.
Rectangle $PRSQ$, listing corners by jumping across instead of travelling the boundary.
Only rectangle $PQRS$ is allowed; starting at any other corner makes the name invalid.
Rectangle $PQRS$ is valid only after renaming the corners in alphabetical order first.

teacher.key_rationale: Travel order around the boundary may start at any corner. QRSP continues P→Q→R→S around the edge from Q.
